changes: Changed the verifier.ts no-story CLI-gate gitCwd fallback from projectRoot to the project-level evaluateStoryDirConfigInsideGitRoot resolver, so bare validate --concept (and channel/lint) resolve git in the gitRoot on wrapper-root projects. cwd-only; the --story path (B-2856) and gate semantics are untouched.
usage: Run lattice validate --concept with no --story on a wrapper-root project; the concept gate now runs git diff in the resolved gitRoot instead of failing with Not a git repository.
expectedOutcome: bare validate --concept on a wrapper-root project prints a concept result instead of warning: Not a git repository; plain repos byte-identical.
actualTranscript: Wrapper-root fixture, node dist/cli.js validate --concept (no --story): [concept] pass: 1 symbol(s) deleted, no residual references, deletedSymbols: gone; no Not a git repository. BEFORE: warning: Not a git repository / git diff failed. See evidence/transcript-diff.md.
outcomeDiff: Match - the concept gate does real work on wrapper-root projects; the normal/plain case is unchanged.
limitations: Scoped to the verifier.ts no-story gitCwd fallback. The smoke is not yet wired into the validate battery (F-001, dismissed as a systemic gap shared with B-198c/B-2856 smokes that needs a separate infra wiring story).
pitfalls: The story index.json picked up git merge-conflict markers from the INIT_CHECK reconcile under heavy concurrent main churn and needed a manual repair (took main version). The global lattice binary runs the main-repo dist, so worktree changes must be tested via the worktree dist.
